verses.text: Di words of Nehemiah, Hacaliah pikin. Now for di month Chislev, for di 20th year, as I dey Shushan di palace,
Hanani, one of my brothers, come with some men from Judah, and I ask dem about di Jews wey escape, wey remain from di prisoner land, and about Jerusalem.
Dem talk to me say, “Di people wey remain from di prisoner land for di province dey for big suffering and shame. Di wall of Jerusalem don break down too, and dem don burn im gates with fire.”
When I hear dis words, I sit down and cry, and I mourn for some days. I dey fast and pray before di God of heaven,
and I talk say, “I beg you, Lord, God of heaven, di great and fearful God, wey dey keep covenant and faithful love with dem wey love am and keep im commands,

make your ear dey open now and your eyes dey open, so dat you go hear di prayer of your servant, wey I dey pray before you dis time, day and night, for di pikin dem of Israel your servants, as I dey confess di sins of di pikin dem of Israel wey we don sin against you. Yes, me and my papa house don sin.
We don do bad against you well well, and we no keep di commands, di rules and di laws wey you command your servant Moses.
Remember, I beg you, di word wey you command your servant Moses say, ‘If una do wrong, I go scatter una among di peoples,

but if una return to me and keep my commands and do dem, even if una people wey dem drive away dey di farthest part of heaven, I go gather dem from there and bring dem to di place wey I don choose to make my name dey stay.’
Now dem na your servants and your people, wey you don save with your great power and your strong hand.

Lord, I beg you, make your ear dey open now to di prayer of your servant and to di prayer of your servants wey dey enjoy to fear your name. Make your servant succeed today and show am mercy before dis man.” Now I be di king cupbearer.
For di month Nisan, for di 20th year of King Artaxerxes, when wine dey before am, I take di wine and give am to di king. I never dey sad before am before.
Di king talk to me say, “Why your face dey sad, since you no sick? Dis na nothing but sorrow of heart.” Den fear catch me well well.
I talk to di king say, “Make di king live forever! Why my face no go sad, when di city, di place of my papa dem tombs, dey ruin and dem don burn im gates with fire?”
Den di king talk to me say, “Wetin you dey ask for?” So I pray to di God of heaven.
I talk to di king say, “If e good to di king, and if your servant don find favor before you, make you send me to Judah, to di city of my papa dem tombs, so dat I go build am.”
Di king talk to me, as di queen dey sit by am, say, “How long your journey go be? And when you go return?” So e good to di king to send me, and I give am one time.
I talk to di king too say, “If e good to di king, make dem give me letters to di governors dis side of di River, so dat dem go let me pass until I reach Judah,

and one letter to Asaph, di keeper of di king forest, so dat e go give me wood to make beams for di gates of di castle wey dey di house, and for di wall of di city and for di house wey I go enter.” Di king give me, according to di good hand of my God wey dey on me.
Den I reach di governors dis side of di River and give dem di king letters. Di king don send army captains and horsemen with me.
When Sanballat di Horonite and Tobiah di servant, di Ammonite, hear am, e pain dem well well say person don come to look for di good of di pikin dem of Israel.
So I reach Jerusalem and stay there three days.
I stand up for night, me and some few men with me. I no tell anybody wetin my God put for my heart to do for Jerusalem, and no animal dey with me, only di one wey I dey ride.
I go out for night by di Valley Gate, go toward di Dragon Well and di Dung Gate, and I look di walls of Jerusalem wey don break down and im gates wey fire don burn.
Den I go di Fountain Gate and di King Pool, but no place dey for di animal wey dey under me to pass.
Den I go up for night by di stream and look di wall. Den I turn back and enter by di Valley Gate, and so I return.
Di rulers no know where I go or wetin I do, and I never tell di Jews, di priests, di nobles, di rulers or di rest wey dey do di work.
Den I talk to dem say, “Una see di trouble wey we dey, how Jerusalem dey ruin and im gates dey burn with fire. Come, make we build di wall of Jerusalem so dat we no go be shame again.”
I tell dem about di hand of my God wey good on me, and di king words wey e talk to me. Dem talk say, “Make we stand up and build.” So dem strengthen dem hands for di good work.

But when Sanballat di Horonite, Tobiah di servant, di Ammonite, and Geshem di Arab hear am, dem laugh us, look us down and talk say, “Wetin be dis thing wey una dey do? Una wan rebel against di king?”
Den I answer dem say, “Di God of heaven, na im go make us prosper. So we im servants go stand up and build, but una no get share, right or memory for Jerusalem.”

Den Eliashib di high priest stand up with im brothers di priests and dem build di Sheep Gate. Dem make am holy and set up im doors. Dem make am holy reach di Tower of Hammeah, reach di Tower of Hananel.
Next to am, di men of Jericho build. Next to dem, Zaccur, Imri pikin, build.
Di sons of Hassenaah build di Fish Gate. Dem lay im beams and set up im doors, im bolts and im bars.
Next to dem, Meremoth, Uriah pikin, Hakkoz pikin, repair. Next to dem, Meshullam, Berechiah pikin, Meshezabel pikin, repair. Next to dem, Zadok, Baana pikin, repair.
Next to dem, di Tekoites repair, but dem nobles no put dem neck for di work of dem lords.
Joiada, Paseah pikin, and Meshullam, Besodeiah pikin, repair di Old Gate. Dem lay im beams and set up im doors, im bolts and im bars.
Next to dem, Melatiah di Gibeonite, Jadon di Meronothite, di men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, wey belong to di area of di governor dis side of di River, repair.
Next to am, Uzziel, Harhaiah pikin, one of di goldsmiths, repair. Next to am, Hananiah, one of di perfume makers, repair, and dem make Jerusalem strong reach di Broad Wall.
Next to dem, Rephaiah, Hur pikin, di ruler of half of di district of Jerusalem, repair.
Next to dem, Jedaiah, Harumaph pikin, repair opposite im house. Next to am, Hattush, Hashabneiah pikin, repair.
Malchijah, Harim pikin, and Hasshub, Pahath Moab pikin, repair another part and di Tower of di Ovens.
Next to am, Shallum, Hallohesh pikin, di ruler of half of di district of Jerusalem, repair, e and im daughters.
Hanun and di people wey dey stay for Zanoah repair di Valley Gate. Dem build am and set up im doors, im bolts and im bars, and 1,000 cubits of di wall reach di Dung Gate.
Malchijah, Rechab pikin, di ruler of di district of Beth Haccherem, repair di Dung Gate. E build am and set up im doors, im bolts and im bars.

Shallun, Colhozeh pikin, di ruler of di district of Mizpah, repair di Fountain Gate. E build am, cover am and set up im doors, im bolts and im bars, and di wall of di Pool of Shelah by di king garden, reach di steps wey dey go down from David city.
After am, Nehemiah, Azbuk pikin, di ruler of half of di district of Beth Zur, repair reach di place opposite David tombs, di pool wey dem make and di house of di mighty men.
After am, di Levites repair, Rehum, Bani pikin. Next to am, Hashabiah, di ruler of half of di district of Keilah, repair for im district.
After am, dem brothers repair, Bavvai, Henadad pikin, di ruler of half of di district of Keilah.
Next to am, Ezer, Jeshua pikin, di ruler of Mizpah, repair another part, opposite di way up to di armory for di turning of di wall.
After am, Baruch, Zabbai pikin, repair another part with all im heart, from di turning of di wall reach di door of di house of Eliashib di high priest.
After am, Meremoth, Uriah pikin, Hakkoz pikin, repair another part, from di door of Eliashib house reach di end of Eliashib house.
After am, di priests, di men of di land round, repair.
After dem, Benjamin and Hasshub repair opposite dem house. After dem, Azariah, Maaseiah pikin, Ananiah pikin, repair by im house.
After am, Binnui, Henadad pikin, repair another part, from Azariah house reach di turning of di wall and reach di corner.
Palal, Uzai pikin, repair opposite di turning of di wall and di tower wey stand out from di king upper house, wey dey by di court of di guard. After am, Pedaiah, Parosh pikin, repair.
Now di temple servants dey stay for Ophel, reach di place opposite di Water Gate toward di east and di tower wey stand out.
After am, di Tekoites repair another part, opposite di great tower wey stand out, reach di wall of Ophel.
Above di Horse Gate, di priests repair, each one opposite im own house.
After dem, Zadok, Immer pikin, repair opposite im own house. After am, Shemaiah, Shecaniah pikin, di keeper of di East Gate, repair.
After am, Hananiah, Shelemiah pikin, and Hanun, Zalaph sixth son, repair another part. After am, Meshullam, Berechiah pikin, repair opposite im room.
After am, Malchijah, one of di goldsmiths, repair reach di house of di temple servants and of di traders, opposite di Inspection Gate and reach di room for di corner.
Between di room for di corner and di Sheep Gate, di goldsmiths and di traders repair.
But e happen say when Sanballat hear say we dey build di wall, e vex and fall into big anger, and e mock di Jews.

E talk before im brothers and di army of Samaria say, “Wetin dis weak Jews dey do? Dem go make dem self strong? Dem go offer sacrifices? Dem go finish am in one day? Dem go bring di stones back to life from di heaps of rubbish, since dem don burn dem?”
Now Tobiah di Ammonite dey by am, and e talk say, “Even wetin dem dey build, if fox climb am, e go break down dem stone wall.”
Hear us, our God, because dem dey look us down. Turn dem shame back on dem own head and give dem as loot for land of prisoners.
No cover dem sin and no let dem wrong rub out from before you, because dem don make di builders vex.
So we build di wall, and all di wall join together reach half of im height, because di people get mind to work.
But when Sanballat, Tobiah, di Arabs, di Ammonites and di Ashdodites hear say di repair of di walls of Jerusalem dey go forward and say di broken places don begin to fill, dem vex well well,
and all of dem plan together to come fight Jerusalem and cause confusion inside am.
But we pray to our God and put guards against dem day and night because of dem.
Judah talk say, “Di strength of di people wey dey carry load don weak, and plenty rubbish dey, so we no fit build di wall.”
Our enemies talk say, “Dem no go know and dem no go see until we reach among dem and kill dem and make di work stop.”
When di Jews wey dey stay near dem come, dem talk to us ten times from every place say, “Una must return to us.”
So I put people for di lowest places behind di wall, for di open places, and I put di people by dem families with dem swords, spears and bows.

I look, I stand up and talk to di nobles, di rulers and di rest of di people say, “No fear dem. Remember di Lord, wey great and fearful, and fight for una brothers, una sons, una daughters, una wives and una houses.”
When our enemies hear say we don know, and God don bring dem plan to nothing, all of us return to di wall, each one to im work.
From dat time half of my servants dey do di work, and half of dem dey hold di spears, di shields, di bows and di armor, and di rulers dey behind all di house of Judah.
Dem wey dey build di wall and dem wey dey carry load, each one dey work with one hand and hold im weapon with di other,
and each of di builders tie im sword for im side as e dey build. Di one wey dey blow di trumpet dey by me.
I talk to di nobles, di rulers and di rest of di people say, “Di work big and wide, and we dey separate for di wall, one far from another.
For any place wey una hear di sound of di trumpet, gather go there to us. Our God go fight for us.”
So we dey work, and half of dem hold di spears from di rising of morning until di stars appear.
For dat same time I talk to di people say, “Make each one with im servant sleep inside Jerusalem, so dat dem go be guard for us for night and work for day.”
So no be me, my brothers, my servants or di men of di guard wey follow me, none of us remove our clothes, only say each one carry im weapon go di water.
Den big cry rise from di people and dem wives against dem brothers di Jews.
Because some dey wey talk say, “We, our sons and our daughters, plenty. Make we get grain so dat we go eat and live.”
Some dey wey talk say, “We dey put our fields, our vineyards and our houses as pledge. Make we get grain because of di hunger.”
Some talk too say, “We don borrow money for di king tax on our fields and our vineyards.

Now our flesh na like di flesh of our brothers, our pikin dem like dem pikin dem. But look, we dey bring our sons and our daughters into slavery to be servants, and some of our daughters don enter slavery already. E no dey our power to help am, because other men get our fields and our vineyards.”
I vex well well when I hear dem cry and dis words.
Den I think am over for my mind, and I argue with di nobles and di rulers and talk to dem say, “Una dey collect interest, each one from im brother.” I call big gathering against dem.

I talk to dem say, “We, according to our power, don buy back our brothers di Jews wey dem sell to di nations. Una wan sell una brothers too, make dem sell dem to us?” Den dem keep quiet and no get word to talk.
I talk too say, “Wetin una dey do no good. Una no suppose waka for di fear of our God, because of di shame from di nations wey be our enemies?
Me, my brothers and my servants dey lend dem money and grain too. I beg una, make we stop dis interest.”
“I beg una, return to dem today dem fields, dem vineyards, dem olive groves and dem houses, and di hundredth part of di money, di grain, di new wine and di oil wey una dey collect from dem.”
Den dem talk say, “We go return dem and no go ask anything from dem. We go do as you talk.” Den I call di priests and make dem swear say dem go do according to dis promise.

I shake out my lap too and talk say, “So make God shake out every man from im house and from im work wey no keep dis promise. Even so make dem shake am out and empty am.” All di gathering talk say, “Amen,” and dem praise di Lord. Di people do according to dis promise.
Also from di time wey dem appoint me to be dia governor for di land of Judah, from di 20th year reach di 32nd year of King Artaxerxes, wey be 12 years, me and my brothers no eat di governor food.

But di governors wey dey before me dey load di people, and dem dey collect bread and wine from dem, plus 40 shekels of silver. Even dem servants dey rule over di people. But I no do so, because of di fear of God.
Yes, I continue for di work of dis wall too, and we no buy any land. All my servants gather there for di work.
Plus dat one, 150 men of di Jews and di rulers dey eat for my table, apart from dem wey come to us from di nations wey dey round us.

Wetin dem prepare for one day na one ox and six good sheep. Dem prepare birds for me too, and every ten days dem prepare all kind of wine. Still, for all dis I no ask for di governor food, because di work heavy on dis people.
Remember me, my God, for good, for all wey I don do for dis people.

Now e happen say when Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem di Arab and di rest of our enemies hear say I don build di wall and say no broken place remain inside am, even though to dat time I never set up di doors for di gates,
Sanballat and Geshem send to me say, “Come, make we meet together for one of di villages for di plain of Ono.” But dem plan to do me wickedness.
I send messengers to dem say, “I dey do big work, so I no fit come down. Why make di work stop as I leave am and come down to una?”
Dem send to me four times like dis, and I answer dem di same way.
Den Sanballat send im servant to me di fifth time with open letter for im hand,
wey dem write inside say, “Dem dey talk among di nations, and Geshem talk am, say you and di Jews dey plan to rebel, and na why you dey build di wall. According to dis words, you wan be dia king.
You don appoint prophets too to preach about you for Jerusalem say, ‘King dey Judah.’ Now dem go report dis words to di king. So come now, make we take advice together.”
Den I send to am say, “Nothing like wetin you talk dey happen, but you dey make dem up from your own heart.”
Because all of dem wan make us fear, dey talk say, “Dem hands go weak for di work, so dat dem no go finish am.” But now, strengthen my hands.

I go di house of Shemaiah, Delaiah pikin, Mehetabel pikin, wey lock imself inside, and e talk say, “Make we meet together for God house, inside di temple, and make we close di doors of di temple, because dem dey come to kill you. Yes, for night dem go come kill you.”
I talk say, “Man like me suppose run? Who for here, wey be like me, go enter di temple to save im life? I no go enter.”
I see clear say God no send am, but e talk dis prophecy against me because Tobiah and Sanballat don hire am.
Dem hire am so dat I go fear, do so and sin, so dat dem go get bad story to shame me.
Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to dis works of dem, and di prophetess Noadiah too, and di rest of di prophets wey wan make me fear.
So dem finish di wall for di 25th day of Elul, inside 52 days.
E happen say when all our enemies hear am, all di nations wey dey round us fear, and dem fall down well well for dem own eyes, because dem see say our God do dis work.
Also for dem days di nobles of Judah dey send plenty letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah letters dey come to dem.
Because plenty for Judah don swear to am, because e be son-in-law of Shecaniah, Arah pikin, and im pikin Jehohanan don marry Meshullam, Berechiah pikin, daughter.
Dem dey talk about im good deeds before me too and dey report my words to am. Tobiah send letters to make me fear.
Now e happen say when dem don build di wall and I don set up di doors, and dem don appoint di gatekeepers, di singers and di Levites,
I give my brother Hanani and Hananiah, di ruler of di castle, charge over Jerusalem, because e be faithful man and e fear God pass plenty people.

I talk to dem say, “No make dem open di gates of Jerusalem until di sun hot. While dem dey stand guard, make dem close di doors and una put bar for dem. Appoint guards from di people wey dey stay for Jerusalem, each one for im own watch and each one opposite im own house.”
Now di city wide and big, but di people inside am few, and dem never build di houses.

My God put am for my heart to gather di nobles, di rulers and di people, so dat dem go register dem by family list. I find di book of di family list of dem wey come up first, and I find dis write inside am:
Dis na di people of di province wey go up from di prisoner land, dem wey Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, don carry go, and wey return go Jerusalem and Judah, each one to im city,
dem wey come with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum and Baanah. Di number of di men of di people of Israel:
Di pikin dem of Parosh, 2,172.
Di pikin dem of Shephatiah, 372.
Di pikin dem of Arah, 652.
Di pikin dem of Pahath Moab, of di pikin dem of Jeshua and Joab, 2,818.
Di pikin dem of Elam, 1,254.
Di pikin dem of Zattu, 845.
Di pikin dem of Zaccai, 760.
Di pikin dem of Binnui, 648.
Di pikin dem of Bebai, 628.
Di pikin dem of Azgad, 2,322.
Di pikin dem of Adonikam, 667.
Di pikin dem of Bigvai, 2,067.
Di pikin dem of Adin, 655.
Di pikin dem of Ater, of Hezekiah, 98.
Di pikin dem of Hashum, 328.
Di pikin dem of Bezai, 324.
Di pikin dem of Hariph, 112.
Di pikin dem of Gibeon, 95.
Di men of Bethlehem and Netophah, 188.
Di men of Anathoth, 128.
Di men of Beth Azmaveth, 42.
Di men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah and Beeroth, 743.
Di men of Ramah and Geba, 621.
Di men of Michmas, 122.
Di men of Bethel and Ai, 123.
Di men of di other Nebo, 52.
Di pikin dem of di other Elam, 1,254.
Di pikin dem of Harim, 320.
Di pikin dem of Jericho, 345.
Di pikin dem of Lod, Hadid and Ono, 721.
Di pikin dem of Senaah, 3,930.
Di priests: di pikin dem of Jedaiah, of di house of Jeshua, 973.
Di pikin dem of Immer, 1,052.
Di pikin dem of Pashhur, 1,247.
Di pikin dem of Harim, 1,017.
Di Levites: di pikin dem of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of di pikin dem of Hodevah, 74.
Di singers: di pikin dem of Asaph, 148.
Di gatekeepers: di pikin dem of Shallum, di pikin dem of Ater, di pikin dem of Talmon, di pikin dem of Akkub, di pikin dem of Hatita and di pikin dem of Shobai, 138.
Di temple servants: di pikin dem of Ziha, di pikin dem of Hasupha, di pikin dem of Tabbaoth,
di pikin dem of Keros, di pikin dem of Sia, di pikin dem of Padon,
di pikin dem of Lebana, di pikin dem of Hagaba, di pikin dem of Shalmai,
di pikin dem of Hanan, di pikin dem of Giddel, di pikin dem of Gahar,
di pikin dem of Reaiah, di pikin dem of Rezin, di pikin dem of Nekoda,
di pikin dem of Gazzam, di pikin dem of Uzza, di pikin dem of Paseah,
di pikin dem of Besai, di pikin dem of Meunim, di pikin dem of Nephishesim,
di pikin dem of Bakbuk, di pikin dem of Hakupha, di pikin dem of Harhur,
di pikin dem of Bazlith, di pikin dem of Mehida, di pikin dem of Harsha,
di pikin dem of Barkos, di pikin dem of Sisera, di pikin dem of Temah,
di pikin dem of Neziah and di pikin dem of Hatipha.
Di pikin dem of Solomon servants: di pikin dem of Sotai, di pikin dem of Sophereth, di pikin dem of Perida,
di pikin dem of Jaala, di pikin dem of Darkon, di pikin dem of Giddel,
di pikin dem of Shephatiah, di pikin dem of Hattil, di pikin dem of Pochereth Hazzebaim and di pikin dem of Amon.
All di temple servants and di pikin dem of Solomon servants na 392.
Dem na di ones wey go up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon and Immer, but dem no fit show dem papa houses or dem family, if dem be of Israel:
di pikin dem of Delaiah, di pikin dem of Tobiah and di pikin dem of Nekoda, 642.
Of di priests: di pikin dem of Hobaiah, di pikin dem of Hakkoz and di pikin dem of Barzillai, wey marry one of di daughters of Barzillai di Gileadite and dem call am by dia name.
Dem look for dem family record among dem wey dem register, but dem no find am, so dem take dem as unclean and remove dem from di priesthood.
Di governor talk to dem say make dem no eat di most holy things until priest stand up with Urim and Thummim.
Di whole gathering together na 42,360,
apart from dem male servants and dem female servants, wey be 7,337. Dem get 245 singing men and singing women.
Dem horses na 736, dem mules 245,
dem camels 435 and dem donkeys 6,720.
Some from among di heads of di papa houses give for di work. Di governor give 1,000 gold coins, 50 basins and 530 priests clothes to di treasury.
Some of di heads of di papa houses give 20,000 gold coins and 2,200 pounds of silver to di treasury of di work.
Wetin di rest of di people give na 20,000 gold coins, 2,000 pounds of silver and 67 priests clothes.

So di priests, di Levites, di gatekeepers, di singers, some of di people, di temple servants and all Israel stay for dem cities. When di seventh month reach, di pikin dem of Israel dey for dem cities.
All di people gather together like one man for di open place wey dey before di Water Gate, and dem talk to Ezra di teacher to bring di book of di law of Moses, wey di Lord don command Israel.
Ezra di priest bring di law before di gathering, both men and women and all wey fit hear and understand, for di first day of di seventh month.

E read from am before di open place wey dey before di Water Gate from early morning until midday, before di men and di women and dem wey fit understand, and di ears of all di people dey attentive to di book of di law.

Ezra di teacher stand on one wood platform wey dem don make for dis purpose. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah and Maaseiah stand by am for im right hand, and for im left hand na Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.
Ezra open di book before all di people, because e dey high above all di people, and when e open am, all di people stand up.
Ezra bless di Lord, di great God. All di people answer, “Amen, Amen,” as dem lift up dem hands, and dem bow dem heads and worship di Lord with dem face to di ground.
Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan and Pelaiah, di Levites, make di people understand di law, and di people stand for dem place.
Dem read for di book, for di law of God, clear clear, and dem give di meaning and make dem understand wetin dem read.

Nehemiah, wey be di governor, and Ezra di priest and teacher, and di Levites wey dey teach di people talk to all di people say, “Today dey holy to di Lord una God. No mourn and no cry.” Because all di people dey cry as dem hear di words of di law.

Den e talk to dem say, “Go una way, eat di fat food, drink di sweet drink and send share to dem wey nothing dey ready for, because today dey holy to our Lord. No grieve, because di joy of di Lord na una strength.”
So di Levites calm all di people, dey talk say, “Keep quiet, because di day dey holy. No grieve.”
All di people go dem way to eat, to drink, to send share and to enjoy well well, because dem don understand di words wey dem tell dem.
For di second day, di heads of di papa houses of all di people, di priests and di Levites gather to Ezra di teacher to pay attention to di words of di law.
Dem find write for di law say di Lord don command by Moses say di pikin dem of Israel go stay for tents for di feast of di seventh month,

and say dem go announce and send word for all dem cities and for Jerusalem say, “Go out to di mountain and bring olive branches, wild olive branches, myrtle branches, palm branches and branches of thick trees to make tents, as dem write am.”

So di people go out and bring dem, and dem make tents for dem self, each one for di roof of im house, for dem courts, for di courts of God house, for di open place of di Water Gate and for di open place of di gate of Ephraim.

All di gathering of dem wey don return from di prisoner land make tents and stay for di tents, because from di days of Joshua, Nun pikin, reach dat day, di pikin dem of Israel no do so. Very big gladness dey.
Day by day, from di first day to di last day, e read from di book of di law of God. Dem keep di feast seven days, and for di eighth day na solemn gathering, according to di rule.
